The Alpha project has a storage capacity of 37 liters, whereas Project Beta stores 92 litres. [E1, E2]

Alpha uses SQLite, while Project Beta uses append-only log files. [E1, E2]

The Alpha project stops writing on Sundays; in contrast, Project Beta permits writes on Sundays. [E1, E2]

Alpha has a storage capacity of 37 liters, uses SQLite, and stops writing on Sundays; Project Beta stores 92 litres, uses append-only log files, and permits writes on Sundays. [E1, E2]

Project Beta permits writes on Sundays and runs backups twice a day, whereas Project Alpha stops writes on Sundays and runs backups once per day. [E2, E1]
